hints: The centre is $(3, -2)$ and point of contact is $P(7, 1)$.
walkthrough:
The tangent intercepts form a right triangle with the coordinate axes.
Calculate radius gradient from centre $(3, -2)$ to $P(7, 1)$:
$$m_{\text{rad}} = \dfrac{1 - (-2)}{7 - 3} = \dfrac{3}{4} \implies m_{\text{tan}} = -\dfrac{4}{3}$$

The tangent intercepts form a right triangle with the coordinate axes.
Find the intercepts of the tangent line $4x + 3y = 31$ with the axes:
$$\text{When } y = 0: \quad 4x = 31 \implies x = \dfrac{31}{4} \implies A\left(\dfrac{31}{4}, 0\right)$$
$$\text{When } x = 0: \quad 3y = 31 \implies y = \dfrac{31}{3} \implies B\left(0, \dfrac{31}{3}\right)$$

Calculate the area of the right-angled triangle $OAB$:
$$\text{Area} = \dfrac{1}{2} \times OA \times OB = \dfrac{1}{2} \times \dfrac{31}{4} \times \dfrac{31}{3} = \dfrac{961}{24}$$
